Expanded report metadata name-list data objects

Source: R/data_names_report_ratio_metadata.R
names_report_ratio_metadata.Rd

Character vectors of indicator names generated from the varlist column in map_headernames. These lists support expanded average, percentile, and ratio-to-average metadata for community report rows.

Details

Expanded report metadata name-list data objects

These objects are generated by data-raw/datacreate_names_of_indicators.R from map_headernames.csv. They are intentionally grouped here because they are internal helper lists rather than separate user-facing datasets.

See also

map_headernames varlist2names() names_d names_e
